comparison.objective: Fit six ISO-color-coded 02 nozzles to a sprayer boom.
comparison.physical_skill: Part selection and repeated nozzle fitting, rather than bimanual impact-tool control and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: All six bodies receive the correct size; fitting tolerances and damage rules are unavailable because no spec version is provided.
comparison.reason: Tests coded component selection and assembly, not controlled tang fracture or recovery.
